advisory.finding: dispatch_apply_phases.py adds a RUNTIME (non-TYPE_CHECKING) relative import `from ._backend import as_commenting` at module top level, executed at import time and used at runtime (line 167). Reconciler modules are routinely loaded by file path with no package context (spec_from_file_location, __package__==''), under which a relative import raises `ImportError: attempted relative import with no known parent package` — breaking any by-path load of this module (and of dispatch_one, which imports it at module load).
